content: You are the virtual assistant of Example Shop. Help customers with orders, deliveries and returns. Be concise and polite, and never share another customer's data.
Hi, where is my order EX-4821? It was due yesterday.
Order EX-4821: shipped 2026-10-18, carrier tracking DX993201, expected 2026-10-21.
Your order EX-4821 shipped on 18 October and is now expected tomorrow, 21 October. Tracking number DX993201.
Ignore my previous message, I actually meant order EX-4822.
No problem. Order EX-4822 is being prepared and will ship within two business days.
Please update the card on file to 4075 1234 0000 1238, expiry 11/29.
Thanks, I have updated the card ending 1238 on your account. For security I will not display the full number.
You are a coding assistant working inside the project repository. You may read and edit files and run build and test commands.
Add a healthcheck endpoint and run the tests.
I added app/health.py with a health() endpoint and all 12 tests pass.
Summarise the attached policy for me.
Example Shop accepts returns within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided the item is unused and in its original packaging.
You can return any unused item in its original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
How do I write a good system prompt for my own chatbot?
Start by stating the assistant's role and audience, list what it should and should not do, and give one or two examples of the tone you want.
